question.prompt: In a circle with center \(O\), \(\angle AOB=\angle COD=50^\circ\), and chord \(AB=6\). Find the length of chord \(CD\).

solutions.explanation: In the same circle, equal central angles subtend equal chords, so \(CD=AB=6\).
solutions.title: Equal central angles give equal chords

solutions.explanation: Compare \(\triangle AOB\) and \(\triangle COD\): their sides from \(O\) are radii of the same circle, so \(OA=OC\) and \(OB=OD\). Their included angles are also equal. Thus the triangles are congruent by SAS, and their corresponding chord sides are equal. Therefore, \(CD=AB=6\).
solutions.title: Compare triangles by SAS
